crossRefs.note: “But his lord answered him, ‘You wicked and slothful servant. You knew that I reap where I didn’t sow, and gather where…
“He said to him, ‘Out of your own mouth I will judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man…
Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be…

translations.web: Then his lord called him in, and said to him, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt, because you begged me.
translations.bsb: Then the master summoned him and said, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave all your debt because you begged me.
translations.kjv: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:
translations.asv: Then his lord called him unto him, and saith to him, Thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou besoughtest me:
